LanguageData.DeepElevator_CandidatesAvailable: {0} unconnected elevator(s) at this position on other levels. Use "Connect to...".
LanguageData.DeepElevator_ConnectDesc: Link this elevator to an unconnected elevator at the same position on another level. The link cannot be changed afterwards.
LanguageData.DeepElevator_RenameDesc: Give this elevator a name. It is shown in the connect menu and messages of the elevators on other levels.
LanguageData.DeepElevator_GoToPartnerDesc: Jump to the linked elevator on the other level.
LanguageData.DeepElevator_HoldTargetsFull: all accepting storage at the destination is full
LanguageData.DeepElevator_HoldNoDropCell: no free cell to put it down at the destination
LanguageData.DeepElevator_HoldDropDisabled: no storage accepts it and dropping on the floor is off
LanguageData.DeepElevator_UnloadDesc: Put everything in this elevator's buffer down nearby. Pawns will haul it to storage.
LanguageData.DeepElevator_UnloadIncomplete: {0}: no room nearby for {1} item stack(s); they stay in the elevator.
LanguageData.DeepElevator_ToggleFifoDesc: On: the buffer is sent strictly in order; if the first entry can't be delivered, everything waits. Off: the first entry that can be delivered is sent.
LanguageData.DeepElevator_ToggleMergeDesc: On: arriving items join any buffered stack of the same kind. Off: every arrival is kept as its own entry.
LanguageData.DeepElevator_ToggleDropDesc: On: items that no storage next to the linked elevator accepts are put down on a free cell next to it. Off: such items wait in this elevator.
LanguageData.DeepElevator_SlotsDesc: Buffer size in slots. A slot holds one full stack. Currently {0}.
